ask.description: Dispatch a task to headless Claude Sonnet via dispatch_claude.py. Usage: /ask <your request>
ask.template:
Run this bash command to dispatch to Claude Sonnet and watch progress:
TS=$(date +%s); OUTF="/home/john/Thunderbird/output/ask_${TS}.md"; DJSON=$(python3 /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/dispatch_claude.py --task "oc-ask-${TS}" --output "${OUTF}" --prompt "{0}" --model sonnet); PID=$(echo "${DJSON}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('pid',0))" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "${PID:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then python3 /home/john/Thunderbird/OpsCenter/watch_task.py "${OUTF}" "${PID}"; else echo "Dispatch failed: ${DJSON}"; fi
